alkylation reagent: the resuspended pellet was alkylated with 15 mm iodoacetamide
alkylation concentration: the resuspended pellet was alkylated with 15 mm iodoacetamide
cleavage agent: The sample was digested using either trypsin (catalog #V5111, Promega) or chymotrypsin (catalog #V106A, Promega)
enrichment method: a liposome flotation assay was conducted using LPC 18:1 and LPC 18:0 micelles to identify proteins that are directly complexing with LPCs.
fractionation method: Mass spectrometry proteomics was performed on a Q Exactive instrument after fractionation on a coupled EASY-nLC 1000 Liquid Chromatography System
instrument: Mass spectrometry proteomics was performed on a Q Exactive instrument
labeling: Our labeled proteomics (iTRAQ) revealed that these four groups (low-recovery, high-recovery, stay-normal, and control no-injection groups) were compositionally distinct from each other
reduction reagent: reduced with 6 m urea and 10 mm dithiothreitol
reduction concentration: reduced with 6 m urea and 10 mm dithiothreitol
